title: Unused Table Occurrence
description: Unused-code rule — table occurrences that can be removed: not used anywhere, or used only as a relationship side with no used table occurrence beyond them (dead branch or island of the relationship graph). Counts every usage, including Table::Field references in formulas, script steps and layout fields; intermediate table occurrences on a path between two used ones (e.g. the join TO of an n:m relationship) are kept.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Orphaned occurrences and dead branches enlarge the relationship graph without adding function.
rule.remediation: Check the finding (dynamic references such as GetField or Evaluate are not visible; in files without DDR info formula references come only from the formula text, so their findings are marked unverified), then remove the occurrence — for a dead branch together with the rest of its dead group.
